summary: Loads VST3 instrument or effect plugins for audio generation/processing, exposing plugin parameters, GUI controls, bus layouts, MIDI callbacks, and playhead context.
key_concepts: Audio VST CHOP loads VST3 plugin files that generate or process audio.
Plugin parameters can be exposed and driven bidirectionally through TouchDesigner parameters or the plugin GUI.
Derivative recommends binding-style workflows for bidirectional plugin parameters rather than plain expressions or CHOP references.
The CHOP can take up to four multichannel inputs depending on the plugin.
Callbacks DATs can handle MIDI messages generated by or sent to the plugin.

key_params.name: loadpluginstate
key_params.note: Restore saved plugin state when TouchDesigner starts

key_params.name: alwaysontop
key_params.note: Keep the plugin GUI above other windows

common_gotchas: VST3 plugin availability, stability, GUI behavior, and bus layouts are plugin-specific.
For bidirectional plugin parameters, official docs recommend binding-style workflows rather than plain expressions or CHOP references.
Plugins can add latency and CPU load; plan monitoring and bypass/failover for live systems.
Callbacks are the path for generated or received MIDI events, so keep callback DATs versioned and explicit.
